verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, and AI-generated insights over simulation data is a capability such a product could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI or LLM-driven insight or suggestion feature. It covers only introspection CLI and GUI tools, sensor data generation, plugins and transport. These are adjacent, non-AI features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
